headline: 173 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Hawk Fire in NV, threatening 20,472 structures.

active_threats.name: Hawk
active_threats.narrative: The Hawk Fire in Washoe County, NV has burned 15,085 acres and is 93% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **20,472 structures threatened**. 570 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 25 mph, sustained near 20) with humidity as low as 19%. A wind shift is expected during the window — the kind of transition that is hardest for a 3 km forecast model to time and place precisely. Forecast wind (SW) is not currently aligned toward Verdi CDP, the nearest community of size, 2 miles away.

places: El Paso de Robles (Paso Robles) city
emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over CA: Salinas city, Santa Maria city, San Luis Obispo city, Hollister city, and El Paso de Robles (Paso Robles) city and 12 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and SPC's **Elevated** fire-weather category and NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 11% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
